summary: Configured node1 with persistent 512 MiB lzo-compressed zram swap at maximum priority 32767. It remained enabled, active, and healthy after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Installed the matching kernel extra-modules package to provide zram support.
Created and enabled zram-swap.service for automatic boot activation.
Configured /dev/zram0 with 536870912 bytes and swap priority 32767.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the service and compressed swap recovered successfully after reboot.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of compressed in-memory swap, active at boot and preferred over disk-backed swap
evidence.summary: Shows a 536870912-byte lzo zram device, active as swap at maximum priority 32767, with zram-swap.service enabled and active before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Captures the healthy baseline and old boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and successful post-restart service and swap recovery.
